title: Ukrainian drones reportedly strike 2 Russian oil refineries in massive attack
summary: Ukrainian forces struck two Russian oil refineries, setting the sites ablaze in a massive attack overnight on Nov. 25, monitoring channels reported.

title: Russian attacks kill 2 in Odesa Oblast, including child, injure more in Kyiv
summary: A Russian attack on Odesa Oblast killed two people, including a teenager, and injured one other person, while another strike on a Kyiv residential building courtyard injured two people in Ukraine's capital late on Nov. 24.
